test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who is the 46th Chief Justice of India?
solution:
The correct answer is Justice Ranjan Gogoi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chief Justice of India is the head of the Indian judiciary and the Supreme Court and is responsible for overseeing judicial functions and administration.
 
• The CJI is appointed by** the President of India**, following the convention of appointing the senior-most judge of the Supreme Court.
 
• The CJI serves until the age of 65, as mandated by the Constitution of India.
 
• The CJI heads the **Collegium system**, which plays a key role in the appointment and transfer of judges to the higher judiciary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 124: **Establishes the Supreme Court of India, outlines the** appointment** of the Chief Justice and other judges, and specifies their qualifications and tenure.
 
• **Article 126:** Provides for the appointment of an** Acting Chief Justice** when the position of the CJI is vacant or when the CJI is unable to discharge their duties.
 
• **Article 127: **Allows the appointment of ad hoc judges in the Supreme Court when there is a lack of quorum among the judges due to vacancies or inability to perform duties.
 
• **Article 129:** Declares the Supreme Court to be a **court of record**, giving it the authority to punish for contempt of itself, under the leadership of the Chief Justice.
 
• **Dhananjaya Yeshwant Chandrachud** is an Indian jurist, who is the **50th** and current chief justice of India serving since **November 2022**.
